method: Per-channel median of the same 7x7 display-sRGB PNG patch at integer x/y. 1440x1000 viewport, DPR1, Chromium SwiftShader. Geometry-ray validation recorded per patch; mixed patches are explicitly labelled and a 7x7 median can miss a 1px seam.
